subject: POC access and evaluation plan — success criteria & onboarding steps
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Claire Hammond <claire@horizonai.com>, Ravi Patel <ravi@horizonai.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: POC access and evaluation plan — success criteria & onboarding steps

Hi Claire / Ravi —

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we can kick off the 2-week POC cleanly: 

POC objective (recap)
- Validate Redwood inference for Horizon AI core search reranking and chat assistant flows at 512-token context, 50-100 qps expected in pilot.

Success criteria (high level)
- Latency: 95th percentile < 250ms for standard rerank requests under pilot load.
- Cost: token cost should be demonstrably <= your current $/1k-token baseline (we'll provide estimates).
- Quality: top-3 reranking accuracy improves over current baseline on the provided eval set by at least 8%.
- Reliability: no more than one service interruption >5m during the pilot window.

Evaluation plan & timeline
- Week 0 (this week): access provisioning & sandbox prep (SSO invites, IP allowlist, service account API key).
- Week 1: ingest sample test data, run automated evals against your eval set, iterate prompts/config.
- Week 2: load test at target QPS, measure latency/cost/regression alerts, summary demo.

Ownership / points of contact
- Redwood: Soojin (AE) — project owner / kickoff; Marcus (Infra Ops) — sandbox & credentials; Vanessa (CS) — success criteria and rollouts.
- Horizon AI: Claire (PM) — evaluator lead; Ravi (Eng) — infra/tech contact.

Immediate asks for Horizon (please reply to confirm):
1) Confirm primary evaluators (emails) and who needs SSO invites.
2) Confirm IP(s) to allowlist for sandbox API access.
3) Confirm kickoff time preference: Fri 11/14 morning PST or Mon 11/17 morning PST (we suggested 11/15 on the call; awaiting your preference).

Attachments: Redwood POC playbook (attached) — contains test harness instructions and sample eval scripts.

I'll loop Marcus to action provisioning after you confirm evaluators and IPs.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

--
Redwood Inference — POC playbook attached: redwood-poc-playbook-v1.pdf

From: Claire Hammond <claire@horizonai.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Ravi Patel <ravi@horizonai.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Nov 2025 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC access and evaluation plan — success criteria & onboarding steps

Thanks Soojin — great summary. We are aligned on the objectives and timeline. A few specifics from our side: 

Confirmed success criteria (we'll own measurement but want Redwood to surface the numbers):
- Rerank: top-3 accuracy uplift >= 8% on our benchmark set.
- Latency: 95p < 250ms at 75 qps sustained.
- Cost: please provide an estimated token cost and projected monthly cost at pilot QPS.

Access and provisioning items (please action):
- SSO invites for: claire@horizonai.com, ravi@horizonai.com, emily.jones@horizonai.com (product manager), and ops@horizonai.com (shared).
- IP allowlist: 203.0.113.45 (office egress).
- Service account API key for CI testing: we prefer a scoped service account tied to a single sandbox project.

Kickoff: 11/15 looks good for us — morning PST (10:00 PST would work). If you can get the sandbox ready by EOD 11/14 that gives us time to confirm access.

Procurement note: our procurement team will need a one-page order form or quote for the POC (short term estimate). Can you loop in pricing?

Thanks — Claire
Claire Hammond
Product Lead | Horizon AI
claire@horizonai.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Cc: Claire Hammond <claire@horizonai.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Nov 2025 13:40:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: POC access and evaluation plan — Horizon AI (action: sandbox & creds)

Marcus — forwarding Claire's confirmation and asks. Please own the infra/provisioning tasks below and reply with ETA. High level: SSO invites, IP allowlist update, create scoped service-account API key, and provision a sandbox preloaded with the small eval set.

Claire asked for:
- SSO invites to: claire@horizonai.com, ravi@horizonai.com, emily.jones@horizonai.com, ops@horizonai.com
- IP allowlist: 203.0.113.45
- Scoped service account API key for CI/testing (single sandbox project).
- Sandbox ready by EOD 11/14; kickoff 11/15 10:00 PST.
- One-page POC quote for procurement (I can draft, but need a rough $/token estimate from pricing).

Can you confirm the following items in reply:
1) ETA for SSO invites and whether we need anything from Horizon to complete SSO (IdP metadata).
2) ETA for IP allowlist change and whether there is a scheduled maintenance window.
3) API key delivery method (we prefer sending via secure link or HubSpot secure note).
4) Sandbox URL and any creds or test endpoints to include in kickoff agenda.

I'll prepare the one-page quote after you share the estimated token/throughput cost (or loop in pricing). Thanks for owning this.

--
SoOJIN LEE
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Scheduled changes:
- IP allowlist update for 203.0.113.45 scheduled for 2025-11-14 02:00 UTC (low-risk window). Please confirm if this works for Horizon.

Notes / next steps:
- I attached a short readme with steps for rotating the service account token and scope details (service-account-key-instructions.txt).
- For procurement: Soojin, we estimate the short POC run to be approximately $1,200–$1,800 depending on prompt length and eval iterations; I recommend offering a POC credit of $1,500 to simplify sign-off.

If Horizon can confirm the IP allowlist window and the evaluator emails can verify they received SSO invites, we should be good to run the kickoff on 2025-11-15 at 10:00 PST.
